note: SELF-004 compare stages: reproducibility is a comparison, and src/selfhost/stages.zig makes it one that can fail. Equal payloads produce an empty comparison and pass. Unequal payloads produce a difference per artifact, naming the artifact and both digests, and the description renders 'first=... second=...' rather than merely 'different'. A different set of artifacts is a failure in both directions: an output one stage stopped producing is named with an explicit absence, because a stage that quietly stopped producing an output is exactly the drift the comparison exists to catch. Artifact names are compared as given - two stages naming the same output differently have not produced comparable outputs, and a fuzzy match would hide that. Fault proof: skipping the digest comparison makes the unequal-payload assertions fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
